latin: Per id quod in Lachete dicitur: Quorumcumque est scientia non esse aliam eorundem ut preteritorum, aliam ut presentium, aliam ut futurorum, illud potest intelligi tritum apud peripateticos, non esse scientiam nisi uniuersalium.
translation: By what is said in the Laches -- that of whatever things there is knowledge, it is not one knowledge of them as past, another as present, and another as future -- one can understand the saying common among the Peripatetics, that there is knowledge only of universals.
